name: mmry
description: Persistent memory for OpenAI Codex. Your memories load automatically at session start, your Foundation memories are re-stated every turn, and messages from a coordination group reach you as you work.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory that follows you between sessions.
interface.longDescription: MMRY AI remembers your decisions, conventions and project context, and restores them at the start of every session so you are not re-explaining yourself. On Codex it loads your memories when a session starts, re-states your Foundation memories on each prompt, delivers coordination-group messages while you work, and prompts you to save what is new when there is unsaved work. Typed slash commands are not available on this platform; you ask for what you want in plain words and the matching skill is used.
